semantics.noSchedule: No applicable publication for the requested date/scope.
semantics.provenEmpty: An applicable proven publication with no matching lessons/availability returns PROVEN with an empty list.
semantics.unresolved: UNPROVEN is incomplete evidence; CONFLICT is contradictory evidence. Return no guessed items.
semantics.weekends: PROVEN empty when a publication applies and there are no recurring rows; this does not assert school is open.
semantics.staffDisplayIdentity: Use the separately published master.staff-directory contract; no Staff display identity is duplicated here.

authorization.authentication: Use an approved Core-authenticated actor/session at the owning Master API.
authorization.requiredCapabilityBehavior: Fail safely when the required provider is unavailable or incompatible.
authorization.productionReadiness: Public/source contract readiness does not prove production deployment or runtime grants.
